default_currency.label: Standard Währung
default_currency.description: Platform Standard Abrechnung Währung für Rechnungen und payments.
default_currency.tooltip: Used when recording payments und am Arbeitsbereich Abrechnung summaries. Beispiel: USD.

vat_percentage.label: VAT / tax percentage
vat_percentage.description: Standard tax rate applied an Abonnement Rechnungen.
vat_percentage.tooltip: Applied during manual Zahlung recording an compute Rechnung tax. Beispiel: 15.

tax_inclusive_pricing.label: Tax-inclusive pricing
tax_inclusive_pricing.description: Whether listed Tarif prices already include tax.
tax_inclusive_pricing.tooltip: Reserved für checkout pricing display. Currently stored für future checkout Integration.

grace_period_days.label: Grace period duration
grace_period_days.description: Tage nach a fehlgeschlagen renewal vor the Abonnement läuft ab.
grace_period_days.tooltip: Used when a renewal fails oder a trial ends ohne Zahlung. Abonnement enters grace period, then läuft ab nach this many Tage.

auto_renewal_default.label: Auto-renewal Standard
auto_renewal_default.description: Standard auto-renewal flag für newly erstellt subscriptions.
auto_renewal_default.tooltip: neu subscriptions inherit this Wert. When off, successful payments do not Zeitplan the weiter renewal Datum.

trial_duration_days.label: Trial duration
trial_duration_days.description: Standard trial length in Tage für neu subscriptions.
trial_duration_days.tooltip: Used when creating a Abonnement mit trial. Beispiel: 14-Tag trial ends 14 Tage nach Start.

invoice_number_format.label: Rechnung number format
invoice_number_format.description: Token pattern für generated Rechnung numbers.
invoice_number_format.tooltip: Tokens: {YYYY}, {MM}, {COMPANY_ID_SHORT}, {SEQ}. Applied when recording a Zahlung.

receipt_number_format.label: Receipt number format
receipt_number_format.description: Token pattern für generated receipt numbers.
receipt_number_format.tooltip: Tokens: {YYYY}, {MM}, {COMPANY_ID_SHORT}, {SEQ}. Applied when recording a Zahlung.

default_payment_terms_days.label: Standard Zahlung terms
default_payment_terms_days.description: Tage until Rechnung Fälligkeitsdatum von issue Datum.
default_payment_terms_days.tooltip: Rechnung Fälligkeitsdatum = issue Datum + this Wert. Visible am Rechnung Verlauf nach Zahlung recording.

invoice_logo_url.label: Rechnung logo URL
invoice_logo_url.description: Platform issuer logo URL für Abrechnung documents.
invoice_logo_url.tooltip: Stored für document branding. PDF generation will consume this in a later phase.

invoice_footer_text.label: Rechnung footer text
invoice_footer_text.description: Footer text am platform Abrechnung documents.
invoice_footer_text.tooltip: Stored für document branding. PDF generation will consume this in a later phase.

issuer_legal_name.label: Issuer legal Name

issuer_address.label: Issuer Adresse
issuer_address.tooltip: Stored für document branding. PDF generation will consume this in a later phase.

issuer_tax_id.label: Issuer tax ID
issuer_tax_id.tooltip: Stored für document branding. PDF generation will consume this in a later phase.

email_template_payment_failed.label: Zahlung fehlgeschlagen Vorlage

webhook_retry_max_attempts.label: Webhook erneut versuchen max attempts
webhook_retry_max_attempts.description: Maximum delivery retries für outbound webhooks.
